## About
Autopoint Sales & Services is a full-service preventive maintenance and automotive repair center in Orlando. We repair domestic and foreign vehicles, and we handle scheduled maintenance for your car, SUV, truck and fleet vehicles.
We're family owned and operated. Our technicians are ASE-certified, we use the latest diagnostic equipment, and we only use quality replacement parts.
Some of our customers have been bringing their cars to us for years. They tell us it's because we're straight with them about what the car needs and what it costs. Call us to set up an appointment, or just stop on by.

## Services
- Air Conditioning Service: Auto A/C system service and air conditioner repair for autos.
- Brake Service & Systems: Brake work for domestic and foreign vehicles.
- Oil, Lube, and Filter: Routine oil service as part of your scheduled maintenance.
- Computerized Engine Analysis: We check what's going on with your engine using diagnostic equipment.
- Wheel Alignment: Wheel alignment and balancing to keep your car tracking straight.
- Cooling System Maintenance: Keeping your cooling system in shape.
- Belts and Hose Inspection: We look over your belts and hoses.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. We repair domestic and foreign vehicles.

Q: What kinds of vehicles do you service?
A: We handle scheduled maintenance for your car, SUV, truck and fleet vehicles.

Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: You can call us to schedule an appointment, or just stop on by.

Q: What parts do you use?
A: We only use quality replacement parts.
